d: Long, flowing ash-blonde hair with blunt-cut bangs and a small red bow on the left side. Bright emerald green eyes with a cheerful, wide-eyed expression, paired with a youthful, teenage face. A slender build, wearing a pink oversized knit sweater over a white collar, a short blue pleated skirt with red trim, white thigh-high stockings with small red bows, and brown loafers. Holding a large, oversized mechanical sword with a black blade and a bulky pink hilt.
